title: Cookies and Cream
author: Cary Ravitz
problems: Row 8 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 7 "robins allemande right 1½ (new robins, on the right diagonal), larks shift left" doesn't work out: Couple 2 must stand side by side to find new neighbors.
Row 1 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 2 "robins chain" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 3 "balance the ring" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 4 "pass through across the set" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
Row 5 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 6 "right left through" can't start from where the dancers are: A right and left through needs two dancers on each side.
Row 7 "robins allemande right 1½ (new robins, on the right diagonal), larks shift left" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the right diagonal.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
